problem_text:
A logistics company needs to select packages to load onto a delivery truck. The available packages are:
* Package A: size 22 cubic feet, revenue $33
* Package B: size 35 cubic feet, revenue $153
* Package C: size 9 cubic feet, revenue $132
* Package D: size 49 cubic feet, revenue $256
* Package E: size 23 cubic feet, revenue $157
* Package F: size 44 cubic feet, revenue $193
* Package G: size 38 cubic feet, revenue $77

The truck has a maximum capacity of 154 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
